_comment: Deliberate overrides applied on top of the compiled plan. These are port decisions, not source facts, so they live here rather than being silently folded into compile_materials.py output.

two_sided.MI_C1_mat_obj_tnl_01: tunnel shell: the source marks the walls two-sided but not this one. One-sided geometry whose normals face the interior is visible to the player and culled in the sun's shadow-depth pass, so sunlight reaches the tunnel floor.

masked_master_split._why: M_AlphaTest ships TwoSided=True, so every instance parented to it renders two-sided regardless of the canonical (canonical: 77 of 1,605 materials are double-sided). The game also ships the one-sided twin M_AlphaTestOneSided — same BLEND_Masked, same 'Texture' parameter. Masked rows the canonical does NOT mark double-sided belong there.
